name: live-deck-site
description: Landing page and docs for Live Deck, served at https://projects.angelsirlopu.dev/live-deck/

scripts.build: npm run validate:deck && npm run docs && vite build && node site/scripts/build-docs.ts --extras dist-site && node site/scripts/check-links.ts
scripts.validate:deck: node live-deck/bin/live-deck.ts validate decks/site-demo && node live-deck/bin/live-deck.ts validate decks/site-demo-es
scripts.deploy: npm run build && rsync -az --delete dist-site/ root@195.200.7.40:/opt/projects/www/live-deck/ && rsync -az deploy/www-root/robots.txt root@195.200.7.40:/opt/projects/www/ && rsync -az dist-site/llms.txt root@195.200.7.40:/opt/projects/www/llms.txt && rsync -az --inplace deploy/nginx.conf deploy/compose.yaml root@195.200.7.40:/opt/projects/ && ssh root@195.200.7.40 'cd /opt/projects && docker compose exec -T projects-web nginx -t && docker compose exec -T projects-web nginx -s reload'
